description: Re-verify an inventory against its sources before it feeds an estimate — every quote, every anchor, every unreferenced passage.
The client sent v2. Diff the inventories so added scope becomes visible and priceable instead of absorbed silently.
Price a Feature Inventory into a ranged, role-split estimate decomposed along the real BMad phases. Band width is computed from input completeness, never chosen.
outputs: estimate.json, estimate.md, estimate.csv, interactive estimate.html, ledger entry

description: A go/no-go in minutes: is this a 400-hour deal or a 4,000-hour one? Totals and risk only, and deliberately records no ledger entry.
Explain a number line by line, defend it under challenge, rehearse the client call, price a what-if or a change request, fit scope to a budget, or triage which deal to work first.
args: {project or question: what you want to talk about}
outputs: scenario re-prices, cut lines, curated cost model, company-profile.md

description: Attach real spent hours to a delivered estimate. A single project total with its scope and exclusions is enough to start calibrating.
Turn delivered actuals into evidence-backed coefficient changes — backtested against history, human-approved, logged and reversible. Most runs should propose nothing.
How accurate are our estimates? Estimate-versus-actual over time, and which projects never came back with hours.
